en: How I love you! How I fear you!
I must have seen you in an evil hour!
Oh, not for nothing are you darker than the deep!
I see in you mourning for my soul,
I see in you a victorious flame:
On it a poor heart is burnt.
But I am not sad, I am not sorrowful,
My fate is a comfort to me:
All the best in life that God gave us
I have given as a sacrifice to fiery eyes!
rom: Kak ljublju ja vas! Kak bojusʹ ja vas!
Znatʹ uvidel vas ja v nedobryj čas!
Vižu traur v vas po duše moej,
Vižu plamja v vas ja pobednoe:
No ne grusten ja, ne pečalen ja,
Vsë, čto lučšego v žizni Bog dal nam,
V žertvu otdal ja ognevym glazam!
notes: line 1.4: 'Знать' is colloquial for 'it seems, evidently': 'I must have seen you', not 'to know'.
line 1.4: 'в недобрый час', literally 'in an unkind hour': an ill-omened moment.
line 1.1: 'черные' is literally 'black' (the song is known in English as 'Dark Eyes').
line 2.1: 'глубины темней', darker than the depth(s) (of the sea is implied, not said).
line 3.3: the original says 'gave us' (нам) and 'I gave' (я): kept as written.
Text: as given by Wikisource for Hrebinka's 1843 poem; the sung version adds and changes stanzas.
